title: The fountain proposal
premise: Marcus proposes in front of a crowd, she says no and drives off with the man with the gold watch. Two years later his car pulls up beside theirs.

shots.image_prompt: close shot, chest up, a fountain square in front of a grand old hotel, a crowd of adult onlookers in their thirties holding up phones, warm orange sunset light, {jess}, in a short red dress with a small white bag on a shoulder strap at her hip, recoiling with both palms up in front of her and her head pulled back, nose wrinkled, one eyebrow raised in disbelief, mouth open mid-word, the crowd behind her gasping. She is turned toward the left of the frame, looking at someone just off camera. Vertical composition, no text anywhere in the image.
shots.motion_prompt: Jess pulls her hands back as if from something hot and her mouth moves as she says it flat and loud, then she rolls her eyes. Fast push-in on her face as the crowd behind her gasps.
shots.speaker: jess
